name: Hedron network
description: The network of stone structures built by Nahiri to form the bars of a worldwide prison, and later used to trap Ulamog.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin imprison the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar using a network of hedrons built by Nahiri.
Gideon, Jace and Nissa trap Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Gideon lured the titan into the center of the ring while the other two activated the network, imprisoning Ulamog.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis arrives and knocks the hedrons out of alignment to siphon their energy and reignite his spark.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis knocked the hedrons out of alignment to siphon their energy and reignite his Planeswalker spark.

relations.note: He built his own hedron network over decades.
relations.quote: It was the keystone in the hedron network I had created

relations.note: Nahiri constructed the hedron network at Ugin's direction.
relations.quote: At Ugin's direction, Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone structures called hedrons

pages_say.description: The network of floating stone hedrons and leylines on Zendikar that was designed to contain the Eldrazi and now lies damaged.
The network of hedrons that Ob Nixilis built with a keystone and that the Zendikari reproduced on a vast scale around Ulamog.
The network of stone structures built by Nahiri to form the bars of a worldwide prison, and later used to trap Ulamog.
The network of hedrons that imprisoned the titans and dampened their energy.
A network on Zendikar that Jace compares to the cryptolith network.
